# Title: CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework

Authors: Qi Li , Zhaojie Kang , Yingjie He , Zheng Lin , Hao Zhang , Guangxin Wu , Yan Gong , Rong Fu , Jianyuan Ni

View a PDF of the paper titled CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework, by Qi Li and 8 other authors

View PDF HTML (experimental)

> Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable success in STEM domains, where progress is often driven by vertical, step-by-step deduction under relatively stable symbol systems. Their horizontal, interdisciplinary cultural reasoning, however, remains this http URL propose CM2, a multi-agent framework grounded in the cognitive pathway of human cultural interpretation. CM2 integrates multimodal perception, retrieval-augmented generation, networked reasoning, gated fusion, and reward-driven this http URL on CM2D across multiple MLLM backbones show consistent gains over CoT and typical reasoning paradigms; ablations validate each module's contribution, and conflict analyses confirm genuine cross-modal arbitration.

Accepted to the 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (PRICAI 2026) as a short paper. 11 pages, 4 figures. Code and dataset are available at this https URL

summaryZh: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在跨学科文化推理能力上的不足，本文提出了CM2多智能体框架。该框架模拟人类文化认知的路径，集成了多模态感知、检索增强生成（RAG）、网络化推理、门控融合及奖励驱动反馈机制。实验结果表明，CM2在文化推理任务中显著优于传统的思维链（CoT）范式，并通过消融实验验证了各模块在跨模态仲裁中的有效性，为解决复杂文化语境下的推理难题提供了新思路。

aiReview.reasonZh: CM2框架通过多智能体协作提升了多模态模型在复杂文化推理任务中的表现，具有较强的创新性。
aiReview.summaryZh: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在跨学科文化推理能力上的不足，本文提出了CM2多智能体框架。该框架模拟人类文化认知的路径，集成了多模态感知、检索增强生成（RAG）、网络化推理、门控融合及奖励驱动反馈机制。实验结果表明，CM2在文化推理任务中显著优于传统的思维链（CoT）范式，并通过消融实验验证了各模块在跨模态仲裁中的有效性，为解决复杂文化语境下的推理难题提供了新思路。

glossary.explanationZh: 多模态大语言模型，具备处理文本、图像等多种模态输入的能力。
检索增强生成，通过外部知识库检索辅助模型生成更准确的内容。
网络化推理，指通过多智能体节点间的交互进行逻辑推演。
门控融合，一种控制不同模态信息权重分配的机制。
